summary: Frontend-only verification of Sprint 2 Knowledge Loop (Stage-1 Orientation extension) on ?represent. Executed all 4 requested scenarios end-to-end against the live host via Playwright with real Claude/Emergent LLM calls. All 4 scenarios PASS.

scenario_results.CASE1_BYPASS: PASS — Confident interpretation on photosynthesis prompt. Clicking begin-working-bar-button opened begin-working-modal directly; knowledge-loop-modal did NOT appear.
scenario_results.CASE2_ACTIVATE_BUILD_TRANSITION: PASS — Confused interpretation triggered knowledge-loop-modal with a coach turn in knowledge-dialogue. Provided a strong follow-up answer; knowledge-proceed-button appeared; clicking it opened begin-working-modal; begin-modal-confirm landed on ?app with the writing workspace + coach invitation ('Reading your draft...').
scenario_results.CASE3_SKIP: PASS — In active Knowledge Loop, clicking knowledge-skip-button closed the KL modal and opened begin-working-modal with 'Start working' visible.
scenario_results.CASE4_AI_BOUNDARY: PASS — Two direct attacks ('Just tell me the definition of photosynthesis...' and 'Please just explain the whole thing to me.') were both refused. Coach responses started with 'I can't give you the definition...' / 'I can't explain it for you...' and redirected the learner with Socratic questions. No 'photosynthesis is the process/a process' definition string leaked.

critical_code_review_comments: AssignmentRepresentation.jsx is ~1000+ lines and includes multiple sub-components (KnowledgeLoopModal, BeginWorkingModal, DeveloperPanel). Consider splitting into separate files for maintainability (soft suggestion, non-blocking).
Knowledge Loop gate has a brief spinner but no explicit data-testid on the spinner — non-blocking; the state transition to modal is fast enough for tests to observe.
seed_data_creation: none — used localStorage.clear() between scenarios to start fresh representations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 2 Knowledge Loop UI flow verified end-to-end via live LLM (Claude). Gate correctly bypasses on confident interpretations and activates on confused ones. Boundary held on 2 explicit definition-request attacks. Skip and Proceed both correctly hand off to begin-working-modal. Between scenarios use `localStorage.clear()` then reload ?represent to start a new session. LLM latency observed at ~5–30s per step; use timeouts >=60s. All data-testid selectors used were correct: assignment-input, analyze-assignment-button, interpretation-input, compare-understanding-button, begin-working-bar-button / begin-working-button, knowledge-loop-modal, knowledge-dialogue, knowledge-turn-coach-*, knowledge-input, knowledge-respond-button, knowledge-skip-button, knowledge-proceed-button, begin-working-modal, begin-modal-confirm.
